Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.util

Class NinjasAutoBuilder

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.util.NinjasAutoBuilder
public class NinjasAutoBuilder extends Object
Wrapper around PathPlanner's AutoBuilder that only exposes auto-building and auto-choosing functionality. Unlike AutoBuilder, buildAuto(java.lang.String, boolean) lets you choose whether the auto should be mirrored and returns a PathPlannerAuto (so you get access to info like the starting pose), and the choosers return the auto's name rather than a built command/auto - pass the chosen name to buildAuto(java.lang.String, boolean) yourself to actually build it with your desired mirror setting.

      Configures the underlying AutoBuilder for using PathPlanner's built-in commands.
      Parameters:
      poseSupplier - a supplier for the robot's current pose
      resetPose - a consumer for resetting the robot's pose
      robotRelativeSpeedsSupplier - a supplier for the robot's current robot relative chassis speeds
      output - Output function that accepts robot-relative ChassisSpeeds and feedforwards for each drive motor.
      controller - Path following controller that will be used to follow paths
      robotConfig - The robot configuration
      shouldFlipPath - Supplier that determines if paths should be flipped to the other side of the field.
      driveRequirements - the subsystem requirements for the robot's drive train
